title: Training and validation of a novel non-invasive imaging system for ruling out malignancy in canine subcutaneous and cutaneous masses using machine learning in 664 masses
summary: Prospective fixed-algorithm thermography validation against cytology/histopathology in 299 dogs/525 masses; 45/53 malignant and 253/378 benign correctly classified (sensitivity 85%, specificity 67%, NPV 97%; eight false negatives were mast cell tumors). The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
